_comment: `main.js` defers `wait.js`, which has a top-level `await`, and then imports the external module `ext`. Native ESM runs `wait` before `ext`. With `preserveModules`, the file of `main.js` imports `ext` at load, and only its body prepares `wait.js`, so the build lowers the deferred import (the warning). In a build with one chunk, `ext` runs first also without `import defer`, so that build keeps the deferral.
